name: Discover Architecture
org: School of Architecture, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
what_you_do: One week on campus in a design studio. You learn drawing, model making and design. You also build bridges, tour campus buildings and take a field trip to a famous architecture town.
who_can_apply: High school students who are rising sophomores through seniors. Students come from around the country.
pay_detail: Program fee $1,300 (includes lodging and meals). The page also mentions a $100 non-refundable fee. A partial-tuition scholarship for two students is offered (apply with a one-page essay).
duration: One week, July 11 to 17, 2027 (residential, on campus)
deadline_text: Registration opens Nov 1, 2026. No due date; it closes when the program is full.
how_to_apply: Register on the program page starting Nov 1, 2026. For the scholarship, also submit a one-page essay on why you want to be an architect by the deadline.
notes: Contact: Elizabeth Abosch, eabosch2@illinois.edu. There are no refunds if you cancel, miss days or come for part of it. Sign up early, because spots fill.
